name: Tangent Audio Bone-Conduction Headband
description:
A slim headband embedded with bone-conduction transducers that deliver audio directly through the skull, leaving the ears completely unobstructed. The band is covered in moisture-wicking fabric and looks like an ordinary athletic headband. Controls are touch-sensitive pads disguised as decorative stitching.

Used by operatives who need comm audio without visible earpieces, athletes who want music without blocking environmental sound, and augmented individuals whose ear canals have been modified in ways that make traditional earbuds impractical.
functionality: Bone-conduction audio, covert comm reception, open-ear design
what_it_says: You're listening to something nobody else can hear, and your ears are still free to catch everything around you.
story_hooks: A dead courier's bone-conduction headband is still receiving transmissions from an encrypted channel — someone is still sending orders to a person who can no longer follow them.
